EnumChange.description: One added, removed or changed enum.

options.description: The options added or removed, ordered by name; empty for an added or removed enum.

records.description:
The Records on each side whose struct declares or inherits a property of this enum, each
Record counted once.

KindCounts.description: The number of definitions per change kind.

added.description: Definitions only the new side has.

changed.description: Definitions both sides have that differ.

removed.description: Definitions only the old side has.

OptionChange.description: One added or removed option of a changed enum.

OptionChangeKind.description: How an enum option differs between the two sides.

oneOf.description: Only the new side has the option.
Only the old side has the option.

ParentChange.description: The parent of a struct on each side.

new.description: The parent on the new side, `null` for none.

old.description: The parent on the old side, `null` for none.

PropertyAspect.description: An aspect of a property that differs.

PropertyChange.description: One added, removed or changed property of a changed struct.

aspects.description:
What differs, in the order data type, conversion, target; empty for an added or removed
property.

new.description: The property on the new side, absent when it was removed.

old.description: The property on the old side, absent when it was added.

PropertyShape.description: What a property is: its type, conversion and target.

conversion.description: The conversion type: `0` for one value, any other code for an array of values.

data_type.description: The data type, e.g. `Reference`, `String` or `Class`; `Unknown(0x…)` for an unknown code.

target.description:
The name of the struct or enum the values are of, point to or refer to; `null` for a
property without a target.

SchemaChangeKind.description: How a struct, property or enum differs between the two sides.

oneOf.description: Only the new side has it.
Only the old side has it.
Both sides have it and it differs.

SchemaCounts.description: The number of changes per kind and level of the schema.

options.description: The option changes of the changed enums.

properties.description: The property changes of the changed structs.

new.description: The count on the new side.

old.description: The count on the old side.

archive.description: The path the Archive was opened from.

build.description: The Build from the Channel's build manifest, `null` when it is unknown.

change_number.description: The Perforce change number the Build was made from.

channel.description: The Channel: the name of the folder holding the Archive, `null` when there is none.

Sources.description: The two Archives of a Comparison.

new.description: The Archive the changes lead to.

old.description: The Archive the changes start from.

StructChange.description: One added, removed or changed struct.

parent.description: The parents, present when a changed struct inherits from another struct than before.

properties.description:
The properties the struct declares itself that differ, ordered by name; empty for an added
or removed struct.

records.description:
The Records on each side whose struct is this struct or inherits from it; `0` on the side
that lacks the struct.

description: The JSON report of the schema drift between the DataForges of an old and a new Archive.

counts.description: The number of changes per kind and level.

enums.description: Every added, removed or changed enum, ordered by name.

format_version.description: The version of the report shape.

structs.description: Every added, removed or changed struct, ordered by name.

unreadable.description:
The definitions, properties, options and Records on each side that were left out because a
name or struct cannot be read or a name is defined twice.
